g.title: HG_QSP
g.text: comparison against an adapting GFRAL set-point → area postrema → NTS → emesis → volume/chloride/thiamine cascade

Pink = feto-placental source · Blue = GDF15/GFRAL axis · Violet = adapting set-point · Green = hindbrain/CNS · Peach = peripheral GI limb · Teal = endocrine/metabolic · Orange = drug · Purple = biomarker · Red = injury · Grey = endpoint · Yellow = genetics
